plan: Store a copied list of {id, label} appointment dictionaries and initialize the public session dictionary from an immutable initial-state template.
Route handle(action) through a dispatch table keyed on action['type'], returning an explanatory Error screen for non-dict actions or unknown types.

In each action handler, run all guards (active/incomplete session, field type checks, known appointment ids, completion prerequisites) before any session mutation, so rejected actions leave accepted data untouched.
Build every screen through one factory that emits exactly {prompt, messages, choices} and includes appointment choices in input order precisely when the prompt is 'Choose appointment'.

Derive the post-correction prompt from the first unmet requirement (contact confirmed, then appointment chosen, then review), and hard-code the contract prompts/messages for begin, confirm, choose, complete, and abandon.
Implement run_once() to raise RuntimeError if either port is missing, then read one action, handle it, display the resulting screen exactly once, and return that same screen object.
Support replaceable I/O by depending only on duck-typed action_source.read_action() and screen_sink.display(screen), fakeable with plain standard-library unittest classes.
mechanisms: Dispatch table mapping action type strings to handler methods
Initial-session template copied for construction, begin, and abandon resets
Guard-before-mutation validation returning 'Error:'-prefixed screens without raising
Single screen factory coupling choice emission to the 'Choose appointment' prompt
Constructor-injected action source and screen sink ports with a RuntimeError precondition in run_once
